title: Skincare Routine Adherence
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skincare:routine
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(step="done",1,0))) as done, dc(step_name) as planned by _time routine
| eval adherence=round(100*done/planned,1)
| stats avg(adherence) as avg_adherence by routine
description: Tracks how consistently you complete your morning and evening skincare routines.
value: Skincare results come from consistency, not products; an adherence view keeps the routine on track.
implementation: Ingest routine steps into `index=personal`; track completion of each routine.
visualization: Bar chart of routine adherence, morning versus evening.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how consistently you do your skincare routine, which is what actually gets results.
